# Apple macOS 27 SDK vs BifrOSt: index and parity matrix

Generated by `bifrost pc parity build` from `docs/parity-matrix/` (do not edit by hand; edit the data files).
What BifrOSt has built against each framework Apple documents for macOS 27 (Golden Gate), and what remains.
Apple side: the official developer documentation only (developer.apple.com DocC data, read with
`tools/parity/docc.py`; each framework page was also rendered in Chromium and recorded with REA, whose
`evidence_id` is listed per framework). BifrOSt side: code and docs in this repo, cited by path; a cited path that
does not exist is marked "(not found)". Rows were filled by agents; treat a row as a pointer to check.

Status: **Parity** app-facing API covers the main features; **Partial** some features; **OS only** the system
layer has it but apps get no SDK API; **Gap** relevant to a macOS-style desktop and missing; **n/a** tied to
Apple-only hardware, stores, services or other platforms. Coverage: rows that apply score Parity 1, Partial and
OS only 0.5, Gap 0, divided by the rows that apply (n/a rows excluded). AppKit, Foundation, SwiftUI and AVFoundation
are split into parts by their official topic sections.

## Summary: created vs remaining

- Coverage over all applicable feature rows: **46.6%** (1935 applicable of 2413 rows).
- Built (Partial or Parity) share of applicable rows: **82.0%**; the deploy gate is 80%.
- Frameworks and parts assessed: **246**.
- Created: **183** (Parity 0, Partial 162, OS only 21).
- Remaining: **0** Gap, plus the missing features inside the 162 Partial ones.
- Not applicable: **63**.

## Remaining work (Gap and Partial, lowest coverage first)

### App Frameworks

- **Swift** (Partial, 38%): Actor isolation and async/await for apps (no actor type in the SDK; springboard/sdk/src/dispatch.rs is callback-based); Regex builder or regex matching API for app text search; Distributed actors (remote calls between app processes); withObservationTracking-style automatic dependency capture in springboard/sdk/src/observable.rs
- **Symbols** (Partial, 39%): No symbol-effect API: appear, bounce, disappear, pulse, scale, variableColor, replace and automatic cannot be applied to a glyph; No discrete or indefinite effect protocols and no SymbolEffectOptions (repeat, speed) for starting or stopping a looping effect; No content transition for swapping one symbol for another; a glyph change is a plain redraw; No draw-on and draw-off, breathe, rotate or wiggle effects; glyphs have no stroke-progress or per-layer state
- **Observation** (Partial, 42%): No @Observable macro equivalent: each Observable must be wired by hand, and with_observation_tracking tracks only SDK Observable reads.; No withContinuousObservation(options:apply:), ObservationTracking.Options, Event or Token: with_observation_tracking is one-shot and returns only the closure value.; Observations is pull-based (try_next), not an AsyncSequence; there is no executor or suspension in the pure std model.; docs/bifrost-ui.md:1435 still describes the old re-entrant set limit; that shared doc is out of scope for this change and is listed for a later update.
- **Evaluations** (Partial, 43%): No model-quality evaluation harness: no suite definition, sample runner or scoring for the Assistant or any on-device model feature.; No datasets, loaders or synthetic sample generation for model tests.; No metric, evaluator or aggregation types, and no model-judge scoring.; No tool-call trajectory checks for agentic features.
- **Foundation Models** (Partial, 43%): No on-device language model and no SDK API for it: an app cannot ask the system for text generation without a network call.; No model session type with instructions, prompts, generation options and streamed partial output.; No guided generation: model output cannot be constrained to a typed schema.; No model-invoked tool calling; App Intents (springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs) exist but are not exposed to a model.
- **SwiftUI (Views, View layout)** (Partial, 44%): Declarative View protocol with body, modifiers and state/binding updates; Environment values and style protocols; Layout protocol and ZStack, lazy grids, ViewThatFits; Shape, Path and Canvas drawing API for apps
- **Bundle Resources** (Partial, 44%): No privacy manifest: an app cannot declare the data it collects or its required-reason API use (Privacy manifest files).; No universal links service: https links cannot be routed to an installed app by domain association.; No Info.plist equivalent with CFBundle-style keys; manifest.toml is the only identity file and it is not a plist.; URL-scheme routing by the shell is not wired for non-web schemes (docs/default-apps.md, Not done yet).
- **Music Understanding** (Partial, 45%): No audio analysis API in the SDK: no session, no analyze call, no result types for any of the six analyses.; Beat, bar and BPM detection on audio (RhythmResult). Only the project's stored tempo exists.; Musical key detection on audio (KeyResult).; Structure segmentation (sections, segments, phrases) and pace analysis.
- **PaperKit** (Partial, 46%): No app-facing SDK markup API: no view controller, no markup data model, no shared type. Apps cannot embed a markup canvas.; No vector elements: shapes, text boxes, images, links and loupes are all missing; every mark is a raster stamp.; No editable, reloadable markup document; the shell and Freeform save a flattened PNG and discard the strokes.; No redo, no stroke selection or editing, no stylus pressure or tilt.
- **SwiftData** (Partial, 46%): No model layer: no declarative model type, schema, or SDK-level container and context for persistent objects.; No queryable record store: no predicate or sort-descriptor fetch over persistent records, and no live results that update views.; No relationships, uniqueness or index constraints between stored records.; No pluggable data store interface and no store-level batching.
- **SwiftUI (App structure, Data and storage)** (Partial, 46%): No declarative App/Scene/View protocol tree; No multi-window openWindow API for one app; No environment values or preference keys propagated through a view hierarchy; No SwiftData/Core Data style model store
- **Accessibility** (Partial, 50%): No app emits controls_tree, so the parent and hierarchy API is unused and every app is a flat list to screen readers.; The AT-SPI bridge is untested on a live Orca; unit tests cover only wire round trips and mapping.; Shell chrome (menu bar, dock, Spotlight, Settings pages) is missing from the AT-SPI tree.; ax_set ignores SetValue and Focus unless an app overrides it; the shared kit's sliders and text fields do not.
- **AppKit (Graphics, Drawing, Color, and Printing)** (Partial, 50%): Shell-drawn print sheet and page layout panel (print.rs has no run_modal); Public Bezier path, gradient and shadow drawing API; NSImage-style object model with representations, template images and more formats; SDK access to PDF rendering (currently inside the Books shell engine)
- **AppKit (Text)** (Partial, 50%): Multi-line text view widget (NSTextView); TextKit layout manager and text containers; Paragraph styles, text lists, tables and attachments in attributed text; Writing Tools integration for text views
- **AppKit (User Interactions)** (Partial, 50%): Scroll wheel, hover and tracking-area events for apps; NSCursor-style cursor API; Dock tile custom content and Dock menu; Trackpad magnify and rotate gestures to apps
- **Distributed** (Partial, 50%): No location-transparent remote actor references or actor system; no SDK type for a remote handle to another app's object; No typed remote-call encoder or decoder: control methods pass untyped JSON params and results; No local test double for cross-process calls (LocalTestingDistributedActorSystem equivalent); Cross-app notifications are string-to-string only, capped at 32 entries and 1024 characters per value
- **Foundation (App Support)** (Partial, 50%): ProgressManager and publishing progress to other processes; value observation of progress for views; Per-domain error user info providers and a recovery attempter that runs the chosen option; Cancelling a progress object does not reach its children; NSUserActivity Handoff between devices
- **Foundation (Fundamentals)** (Partial, 50%): Predicate and expression engine (NSPredicate, Predicate); Regular expression and natural-language text analysis API; Time zones and non-Gregorian calendars; Progress tree (ProgressManager, Subprogress)
- **StateReporting** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing StateReporter: apps cannot declare domains or report state transitions.; No reportable-metadata type or derive macro for attaching structured values to reports.; No signposter (OSSignposter equivalent) for marking intervals and events in traces.; Crash logs are not linked to app state; a crash carries only a signature and file path (springboard/src/shell/diag.rs).
- **SwiftUI (Event handling, Accessibility, Framework integration)** (Partial, 54%): Accessibility rotors; Live-region announcements and custom actions; Reduce-motion and increase-contrast flags; Declarative gesture composition
- **Foundation (Networking, Low-Level Utilities)** (Partial, 54%): Bonjour/mDNS discovery and advertising; WebSocket and stream tasks; Cookie storage, credentials and auth challenges in URLSession; Upload tasks, background sessions, disk URLCache
- **Visual Intelligence** (Partial, 58%): No system delivery of camera or screenshot scenes to third-party apps (the core of the framework).; No app return path for visual matches (an app cannot answer a scene query with results).; No scene classification labels (SemanticContentDescriptor.labels) and no pixel-buffer scene type for apps.; No object selection in screenshots feeding a search.
- **AppKit (App Structure)** (Partial, 62%): Cocoa Bindings controllers and declarative bindings; nib/storyboard-style resource loading; General app extension host and packaging; iCloud-style document and key-value sync API
- **Foundation (Files and Data Persistence)** (Partial, 62%): FileManager-style SDK API (copy, move, attributes, enumerators); Keyed archiver and binary plist; Metadata query over files; iCloud / cloud-synced documents and key-value store
- **AppKit (User Interface)** (Partial, 71%): App-facing sound, speech synthesis and haptics API; NSScreen-style multi-display API for apps; App dock tile badges/menus and custom cursors; Full accessibility roles and rotors

### App Services

- **Matter** (Partial, 25%): No Matter controller: no fabric, certificates, commissioning or interaction model, in the shell or the SDK.; No Thread support: no border router, no Thread network credentials and no OpenThread stack.; No mDNS or DNS-SD transport: the name and TXT parsers in springboard/core/src/matter.rs have no multicast responder or querier, and apps cannot browse services. The only LAN beacon is springboard/src/net/share.rs.; No BLE commissioning path, and no camera or scan source for setup codes. The Bluetooth module handles classic pairing only (springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs).
- **Core Location** (Partial, 33%): No device position source: no GPS, Wi-Fi positioning or geoclue client in springboard/src or netd. Nothing produces a CLLocation-like value.; No location permission in the app manifest and no authorization prompt or status (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs:34).; No SDK module for location in springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (no location module among the pub mod list).; No reverse geocoding (coordinates to placemark). Forward search exists only inside the Weather app (springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs:253).
- **Speech** (Partial, 33%): No speech recognizer or transcription module (SpeechAnalyzer, SpeechTranscriber, DictationTranscriber) in the SDK, the UI kit or the shell.; No SDK API that streams time-coded microphone audio to an app, so a recognizer cannot be fed from an app.; No recognition result type with alternatives, confidence or time ranges.; No custom vocabulary or contextual strings for recognition.
- **CallKit** (Partial, 36%): Call provider and call-state model in the SDK; Incoming and outgoing call UI in the shell; Active-call observation for apps; Caller ID/blocking directory
- **JavaScriptCore** (Partial, 36%): No SDK type for a standalone JavaScript context (JSContext equivalent), so apps cannot run scripts without a web view; No way to expose app objects or functions to scripts (JSExport equivalent); No value bridge between app code and script values beyond text and JSON strings from a web view; No syntax check and no standalone script error reporting outside a web view
- **Social** (Partial, 38%): No compose sheet that posts to a social network (SLComposeViewController equivalent).; No social account store or request signing (SLRequest.account equivalent).; No service-typed HTTP request builder and no multipart body (SLRequest equivalent).; The share menu offers only installed apps, with no per-item NSSharingService objects or delegate callbacks (see docs/bifrost-ui.md, 'Share sheet' gaps).
- **User Notifications UI** (Partial, 38%): App-supplied notification view (UNNotificationContentExtension) with a view controller that renders delivered content; Media play and pause controls on a notification (mediaPlayPauseButton* and mediaPlay()/mediaPause()); Content-extension response options (UNNotificationContentExtensionResponseOption) and dismissal behaviour per action; Notification attachments and userInfo payloads for custom content (noted in docs/bifrost-ui.md, User notifications section)
- **Core Motion** (Partial, 39%): No app-facing Core Motion equivalent in springboard/sdk/src: no CMMotionManager-style API for accelerometer, gyroscope, device motion or attitude.; The orientation feed is missing from this repo: springboard/src/shell/rotate.rs documents set_orientation as fed by the accelerometer every 200 ms, but no non-test caller exists here.; No magnetometer, barometer or altitude readers.; No motion-activity recognition, pedometer or sensor recording or history.
- **QuickLook UI** (Partial, 39%): The shell does not draw the Quick Look panel: ToShell::Preview and PreviewClose are decoded and ignored (springboard/proto/src/lib.rs:677-679).; No app-facing preview extension point: no equivalent of QLPreviewingController or QLPreviewProvider.; No embeddable preview view (QLPreviewView) in the SDK.; The SDK has no built-in file renderers for QLThumbnailGenerator; each app renders its own thumbnails.
- **VisionKit** (Partial, 39%): No text recognition (OCR) for camera frames or images, so Live Text, DataScanner text and ImageAnalyzer have no counterpart.; No document scanning mode (VNDocumentCameraViewController equivalent) in the Camera app or in the SDK.; No subject lifting or background removal for images.; No Visual Look Up.
- **WebKit** (Partial, 39%): No WebDriver implementation for web content (Apple's WebDriver commands for Safari); the testing kit is XCTest-style only.; No WKDOMNodeSnapshot equivalent: no DOM tree snapshot object.; No downloads API (WKDownload, WKDownloadDelegate).; No navigation policy callback (per-request allow or cancel), and stop_loading does nothing because Servo 0.7.0 cannot cancel a load.
- **ExtensionFoundation** (Partial, 40%): Extension point declaration and extension package type; Discovery of installed extensions by host apps; Host-initiated launch of an extension process in its own sandbox with a connection; Share-sheet extensions installed by apps
- **Natural Language** (Partial, 40%): Language recognizer: no text language detection and no hypotheses API; Linguistic tagger: no lexical class, lemma, name type or script tags for apps; Embeddings: no word or sentence vectors and no nearest-neighbour search for apps; Custom NLModel runtime for classifiers and word taggers
- **Core ML** (Partial, 41%): No SDK API to load a model file and run a prediction (MLModel, MLFeatureProvider); No tensor or numeric array type for model inputs and outputs (MLTensor, MLFeatureValue); No compute-device policy exposed to apps (CPU, GPU, Neural Engine); the GPU is used only for rendering; No domain APIs on top of inference: image classification, speech, sound analysis, natural language
- **Safari Services** (Partial, 41%): No standard in-app browser sheet (SFSafariViewController equivalent) for SDK apps; No content-blocking rules API and no ad or tracker blocking; No Safari Reading List (SSReadingList) or Reading List share target; No web extension host, Safari page or tab proxies, or extension messaging
- **Address Book** (Partial, 42%): No SDK API for apps to read, write, or search contacts (the store is shell-internal).; No people picker or person view for apps to embed.; Contacts have one phone, one email and one address; no multi-value properties or primary value.; No groups or group membership; Favorites is a flag only.
- **Notification Center** (Partial, 42%): No app-facing Today widget extension point (NCWidgetProviding): apps cannot supply widget content to the Today View or the home-screen gallery.; No NCWidgetController equivalent: apps cannot report whether their widget has content.; No search results view or list view for widgets (NCWidgetSearchViewController, NCWidgetListViewController).; The Notification Center column does not show widgets: springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs says the shell has no widget data source on the PC yet.
- **Translation** (Partial, 42%): No on-device text translation between language pairs for apps (no TranslationSession equivalent).; No system translation popover or inline translate action for selected text.; No language-pair availability or download-status query (LanguageAvailability).; No translation error model (TranslationError).
- **StoreKit** (Partial, 42%): No purchase API: no product lookup with price, no purchase flow, no paid-app install path (springboard/src/shell/store/api.rs has no price or product type).; No transactions or entitlements API for apps to ask what the user has bought or is entitled to.; No signed transaction verification (JWS) beyond the package sha256 check in springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs.; No subscriptions, renewal state, offers, offer codes or win-back offers.
- **Quick Look** (Partial, 43%): The shell does not draw the floating preview panel: ToShell::Preview and ToShell::PreviewClose are decoded in springboard/proto/src/peek.rs and no handler was found under springboard/src.; No app uses the SDK PreviewPanel or ThumbnailCache. Files keeps its own preview (springboard/apps/files/src/peek.rs).; No third-party preview extension API (QLPreviewProvider, QLPreviewingController, QLFilePreviewRequest, QLPreviewReply).; No QLThumbnailGenerator equivalent: no generator for a file type, no icon-mode badge, no async update, and no drawing of the thumbnail in the panel.
- **Core Data** (Partial, 43%): No object graph: no entity model, relationships, inverse relationships or delete rules.; No fetch requests or predicates; apps filter in-memory vectors.; No managed object context with change tracking, dirty state or faulting.; No database-backed store, so stores are rewritten whole on each save and do not scale past the bounded lists (contacts MAX_ITEMS 10000, calendar MAX_EVENTS 2048).
- **MapKit** (Partial, 43%): No map view or map tile rendering in the SDK or renderer, so no app can show a map; No annotations, overlays or selectable map features; No reverse geocoding (coordinate to place or address); No points-of-interest search, nearby search or search completion beyond city and place text search
- **SiriKit** (Partial, 44%): No Siri voice input or spoken dialog; IntentResult.dialog is returned to the caller but not shown or spoken by Search (docs/bifrost-ui.md 'App Intents').; No parameter resolution, disambiguation or confirmation steps; Search runs only parameterless intents (springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs Intent::validate).; No intent donation (INInteraction and donated shortcuts), so Search cannot suggest what the user did.; No SiriKit domain intents for messaging, media, lists beyond Notes' own intents, or payments; media and messaging are the most relevant for a desktop.
- **TipKit** (Partial, 44%): No tip type, no tip content and no display rules (Tip, Rule, Parameter, Event).; No persistent tip datastore with display frequency limits, and no configure call.; No inline tip view or tip view style.; No anchor modifier that presents a tip popover from an SDK view; the popover exists only as a low-level helper.
- **App Intents** (Partial, 44%): Foreground and background execution modes, and authentication policy on AppIntent; App enums (AppEnum) for predefined parameter values; Parameter types for Double, Files, Currencies, People, Placemarks and Measurements; Snippets and result views, and follow-on intents (OpensAppIntent)
- **Accounts** (Partial, 44%): No system account store (ACAccountStore): no list, save, remove or lookup of user accounts that apps share.; No account type registry and no access-grant prompt (requestAccessToAccounts, accessGranted).; No typed OAuth credential objects, token expiry or credential renewal.; No SDK API for the local OS account (bare/account.rs) or for the BifrOSt cloud account.
- **Core AI** (Partial, 44%): No on-device model runtime (load, specialize, run) for apps in the SDK or the system layer.; No tensor type (NDArray) or inference function signature API.; No compute stream API for apps, so GPU or CPU inference cannot be offloaded from an app.; No model cache or ahead-of-time compile step.
- **Application Services** (Partial, 45%): Accessibility text: selected text, visible range, text markers and caret events are not exposed through the AT-SPI bridge.; Accessibility announcements (live regions) and custom actions beyond press.; ColorSync: no profile, transform or CMM API for apps.; Speech synthesis: no SDK voice or speech channel API.
- **File Provider** (Partial, 45%): No File Provider extension host: no replicated or nonreplicated extension, and no way for an app to register a provider.; No placeholder (dataless) files and no on-demand hydration in Files or the document panel.; No NSFileProviderManager equivalent: no domains, no signalEnumerator, no reimport of remote changes.; No provider search source (NSFileProviderSearching); quick search covers local content only.
- **Background Assets** (Partial, 46%): No app-facing asset-pack API (list, download on demand, status, remove, manifest); No download scheduling that continues or starts while the app is closed, including before first launch; No persistent download queue with essential and non-essential priorities; No localized pack selection
- **Swift Charts** (Partial, 46%): No app-facing chart API: no Chart container, no marks, no scales, no axes, no plots in springboard/sdk or springboard/ui; The Screen Time bar chart and the battery graph are private shell drawers, not reusable by apps; No line, area, point, rectangle, rule or sector marks; No automatic scale domain, no axis grid lines or configurable ticks, no annotations
- **Contacts** (Partial, 47%): No SDK contacts module: apps cannot fetch, search, create or save contacts (springboard/sdk/src/ has no contacts file).; No permission model for contact access (NSContactsUsageDescription equivalent, per-app grant, contact access picker).; No groups, containers or subgroups.; No change history and no contacts-changed notification to apps.
- **Core Text** (Partial, 47%): No app-facing font object or font manager: apps cannot choose a font by family, weight or size from a font descriptor.; No OpenType shaping: no GPOS or kern reader, no ligatures outside colour emoji, no feature selection.; No line or run layout objects for apps: CTLine and CTFramesetter equivalents are missing, so apps cannot measure or hit-test laid-out text.; No paragraph styles: alignment, indents, line spacing and tab stops are missing from the attributed model.
- **WidgetKit** (Partial, 47%): No app-facing widget extension: apps cannot register a widget kind, a size or a configuration (Widget, WidgetBundle, StaticConfiguration, AppIntentConfiguration).; No timeline or reload API for apps (TimelineProvider, TimelineEntry, WidgetCenter.reloadTimelines); shell tiles refresh themselves only.; No Live Activity API (ActivityKit, ActivityConfiguration, DynamicIsland); the lock screen shows shell now-playing only.; No app-provided Control Center controls (ControlWidgetButton, ControlWidgetToggle, ControlValueProvider).
- **CloudKit** (Partial, 50%): App record database with zones and queries; CKSyncEngine-style sync with change tokens; Subscriptions and push; Record sharing between users
- **Contacts UI** (Partial, 50%): No SDK contact picker (CNContactPicker or CNContactPickerViewController equivalent) that returns the chosen contact to an app.; No SDK contact viewer or editor view that other apps can embed; the card and editor are private to contacts-desktop.; The contact store (springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs) is not exposed to apps through the SDK, so no app can read or search contacts.; No contacts permission model. Apps cannot request access, and there is no limited-access state to match ContactAccessButton.
- **Core Spotlight** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing query API (CSSearchQuery, CSUserQuery) and no suggestions, so apps cannot search their own index or build a search field on it.; No index client delegate and no index extensions for on-demand regeneration (CSSearchableIndexDelegate, CSIndexExtensionRequestHandler, CSImportExtension).; Indexing reports no completion or error results (CSIndexError equivalents are missing), so apps cannot tell when an update failed.; Item attributes are limited to title, description, keywords, thumbnail and URL; Apple's custom attribute keys, localized strings and person records are missing.
- **Core Transferable** (Partial, 50%): No Transferable protocol or TransferRepresentation for app model types, so there is no single declaration that drives copy, paste, drag, and share.; The Wayland clipboard publishes only one rich type at a time (springboard/src/shell/pasteboard.rs:33), so typed pasteboard data does not reach other apps in full.; No SentTransferredFile or ReceivedTransferredFile equivalent with sender and receiver roles for file transfers.; No ProxyRepresentation or TransferRepresentationVisibility equivalent.
- **ExtensionKit** (Partial, 50%): No app-extension model: apps cannot publish a UI or service that another app hosts (AppExtensionScene, EXHostViewController).; No extension enable and disable management UI (EXAppExtensionBrowserViewController) for the user to approve or turn off extensions per app.; No out-of-process remote view hosting; ControllerHost in springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs runs in the owner's process only.; Share sheet targets are limited to apps with manifest handles or schemes; app-supplied share extensions are missing (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Share sheet).
- **File Provider UI** (Partial, 50%): No extension point through which a third-party app adds actions to the Files browser's item context menu (the core of this framework).; No hosted extension process that shows a custom action UI over the Files browser and completes or cancels a selected action.; No provider domain model: the system browser cannot list an app's own files as a browsable location.; No typed system action identifiers that apps can register or receive for file actions.
- **Media Intents** (Partial, 50%): No system delivery of audio search requests and no Siri or voice request path for media (springboard/ui/src/media_search.rs models the request, but nothing routes system requests to apps).; AudioSearch.Criteria has no media fields (genre, mood, media type); only search text, unspecified and link are modelled.; No parameter resolution, disambiguation or confirmation for media intents (requestDisambiguation, requestConfirmation are not modelled, docs/bifrost-ui.md:966-973).; No SDK call for an app to publish media metadata or a queue to the shell or to voice requests; Music and Podcasts keep their own state.
- **Preference Panes** (Partial, 50%): No plugin host that loads a third-party pane into the Settings app (NSPreferencePane equivalent), so apps cannot add a settings pane.; No pane lifecycle (select, deselect with veto) or pane notifications for a Settings page.; Apps cannot add items to the shell Help menu or use a help anchor; the Help menu rows are fixed in desktop_bar.rs.; No per-pane initial and last key view, and no text field autosave on pane change.
- **Tabular Data** (Partial, 50%): No DataFrame or typed column container in the SDK or ui crates; No statistical summaries (numeric or categorical); No general CSV reader or writer; only the weather widget parser at springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs; No column-aware JSON import or export
- **WeatherKit** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing weather SDK API in springboard/sdk/src/. Other apps cannot request weather without copying the Open-Meteo code.; No weather alerts (WeatherAlert, severity, availability) from any data source.; No minute forecast.; No historical or statistical weather data (daily and monthly statistics, trends, historical comparisons, percentiles, weather changes).
- **User Notifications** (Partial, 53%): Remote push: no device token, no push registration, no background push wake-up (APNs or a BifrOSt equivalent).; Notification service extension: no hook to modify a notification before it is shown.; Calendar and location triggers: only a time-interval delay exists; no repeating or region-based notifications.; Attachments and per-request sounds: notification cards are text only and the sound is a per-app switch.
- **Combine** (Partial, 54%): combineLatest, merge, filter, flatMap and other operators; Debounce, throttle and schedulers (receive(on:)); Completion and failure types, Demand/back pressure; PassthroughSubject and Future/Just/Empty publishers
- **DataDetection** (Partial, 54%): Email, flight, money and tracking-number detectors; Typed match values (parsed phone, address parts, date with time); Pasteboard detection API; Transit information (needs data)

### Developer Tools

- **App Intents Testing** (Partial, 41%): No intent test helpers: no test session that runs an intent by type and returns a checked result (dispatch() is public but returns raw Json).; No value query results or intent value queries (ResolvedValueQueryResult, IntentValueQueryDefinition).; No entity annotation or onscreen context (ViewAnnotation), so Spotlight and Siri cannot be told what is on screen.; No enum parameter type and no transient entities (AnyAppEnum, AnyTransientAppEntity).
- **Synchronization** (Partial, 42%): No SDK wrapper for Mutex with closure-scoped withLock and withLockIfAvailable; apps use std::sync::Mutex guards directly; No WordPair or double-word atomic in the SDK or the UI, render or core crates; No SDK-level atomic wrapper or documented memory-ordering API; apps reach std::sync::atomic directly; No atomic reference type equivalent to AtomicLazyReference beyond std OnceLock
- **Automator** (Partial, 50%): No workflow engine: multi-step runs, variables and input/output passing between actions do not exist.; Shortcuts actions that need the shell (Wi-Fi, Low Power, Do Not Disturb, brightness, open app, screenshot, timer) are logged, not executed (springboard/apps/shortcuts-desktop/src/main.rs).; No action bundle format or install scan: no equivalent of /System/Library/Automator, /Library/Automator or ~/Library/Automator.; No workflow controller (run, pause, step, stop, reset) and no runWorkflow-by-path API.
- **Scripting Bridge** (Partial, 50%): No generic scripting dictionary (sdef equivalent) and no generated client proxies; callers depend on each app's method list at runtime.; No generic property and element model: apps cannot set properties through a shared API, and element lookup is limited to typed entity queries.; No per-object or per-application last-error state and no failure delegate for callers.; The control socket accepts only the owning user (SO_PEERCRED), so one app cannot script another app that runs under a different account.

### Graphics and Games

- **ColorSync** (Partial, 31%): No ICC profile parser and no profile-to-profile transform engine (ColorSyncTransformCreate and ColorSyncTransformConvert have no equivalent).; No named working spaces (sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB) and no conversion between them, so wide-gamut images and PDF ICCBased colour are drawn as plain RGB.; No display profile or gamma-ramp path: kms.rs reads gamma_size but loads no VCGT or custom profile.; No HDR pipeline (PQ, HLG, extended range, HAGC metadata).
- **SceneKit** (Partial, 35%): No 3D scene graph, camera, light, mesh or material type anywhere in the SDK or render crates; No 3D physics, rigid-body or contact simulation; list scroll physics is 2D only; No particle system, positional audio or 3D asset import; No app-facing custom shader or render-pass API
- **Core Image** (Partial, 38%): No app-facing filter API: no CIFilter-style object, no chaining, and no SDK type for a lazily rendered image (CIImage/CIContext equivalent).; Colour adjustment limited to brightness and contrast (Photos only). Missing: exposure, hue, saturation for app content, temperature and tint, vibrance, tone curve.; Blur limited to one CPU box-blur path and the GPU material blur. Missing: motion, zoom, disc, bokeh, masked variable blur, and a radius or sigma API for apps.; No feature detection (faces, rectangles, text, barcodes) and no barcode or QR generation.
- **ReplayKit** (Partial, 39%): No screen video recording for apps, the shell or the MCP tools (only still screenshots in springboard/src/shell/screenshot.rs).; No SDK API for recording: no RPScreenRecorder equivalent in springboard/sdk/src/.; Microphone recording (springboard/src/media/capture.rs) is not reachable from app SDK code; it is used by Voice Memos only.; No app or system audio capture; audiod does not loop back output.
- **PDFKit** (Partial, 43%): No app-facing PDF document, page or view API in springboard/sdk/src (PDFDocument, PDFPage, PDFView have no counterpart); the PDF reader is private to the Books app; No annotation, widget or form-field support (PDFAnnotation, AcroForm); No page rendering into an app-provided context and no page thumbnails (PDFPage draw, PDFThumbnailView); No text selection or find in PDFs (PDFSelection, PDFDocument find); the reader extracts text only
- **PencilKit** (Partial, 43%): No SDK canvas view or drawing model: apps cannot capture, store or reopen strokes (springboard/sdk/src has no equivalent).; No serialised drawing format; both editors save flattened PNG only.; No handwriting recognition and no Scribble-style input.; No pressure, tilt or altitude data on touch input.
- **Spatial** (Partial, 43%): No 3D vector, point or size types in the SDK (bifrost_app) or the UI kit (bifrost_ui).; No 4x4 affine or projective transform; the renderer and layout use 2D matrices only.; No pose, rotation (quaternion or Euler) or ray types for picking.; Views have no per-view transform or coordinate space conversion (springboard/sdk/src/view/mod.rs).
- **GLKit** (Partial, 44%): No app-facing GL view or drawable: apps cannot create an OpenGL or GLES context on BifrOSt (springboard/src/gpu/mod.rs is internal).; No shader effect classes (GLKBaseEffect and related) and no way for apps to supply shaders.; No 3D math types (matrix, vector, quaternion) in the SDK; only the browser engine's 2D transform.; No mesh or 3D buffer API.
- **GameplayKit** (Partial, 46%): No SDK pathfinding or navigation graph (GKGraph family): no grid, mesh or obstacle graph and no route search.; No SDK random source or distribution API: apps copy an xorshift generator, and only seed() is exposed, under the test kit.; No procedural noise (Perlin, Voronoi, billow, ridged) for apps.; No reusable state machine, entity-component system, or rule and decision system for game logic.
- **Model I/O** (Partial, 46%): 3D scene graph: no MDLAsset or MDLObject equivalent, and no 3D transform stack; Mesh data: no vertex descriptor, index buffer, submesh or buffer allocator exposed to apps; Material and shading model: no material properties, scattering functions or physically based lights; Import and export of 3D formats (OBJ, USD, PLY, STL, Alembic) and no 3D UTTypes in springboard/ui/src/uttype.rs
- **Metal Performance Shaders** (Partial, 47%): No app-facing GPU compute or image-filter API. The GPU path (springboard/src/gpu/) serves the shell only.; No histogram, threshold, morphology, convolution or statistics filters for images.; No neural network or recurrent layers, and no ML inference runtime anywhere in springboard.; No GPU matrix or linear algebra kernels.
- **Quartz** (Partial, 47%): No SDK image view or image browser for apps (ImageKit IKImageView and IKImageBrowserView); image viewing exists only inside the Photos shell app.; No parameterised image filter API (Core Image CIFilter) and no filter browser; Photos has five fixed colour filters.; No scanner support (IKScannerDeviceView) and no SDK camera device browser or picture taker.; The Quick Look panel model in springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs is not drawn by the shell (ToShell::Preview is decoded and ignored) and no app adopts it; no QLPreviewView.
- **SpriteKit** (Partial, 47%): No 2D scene graph with a per-frame update cycle and a camera node for apps (SKScene, SKCameraNode).; No physics world (rigid bodies, gravity, contacts, joints, fields); only list scroll deceleration exists in springboard/ui/src/scroll.rs.; No particle emitter system (SKEmitterNode).; No tile map system (SKTileMapNode and its tile set and rules).
- **Core Animation** (Partial, 50%): No layer tree: no CALayer, sublayers, delegate or layout managers for apps (views only).; No keyframe, group or additive animations, and no key-path animations (typed view properties only).; No transform, corner radius, shadow or mask on views; no 3D transforms.; No shape layer (Bezier paths, stroke and fill rule) and no gradient layer in the SDK.
- **Core Graphics** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing path API (CGPath, CGMutablePath): arbitrary Bezier and polyline drawing, fill and stroke.; No clip rectangle or clip path on the Surface (docs/bifrost-ui.md:867).; No app-facing transform stack or CGAffineTransform; only compositor-side window transforms exist.; No gradient, shading, function or pattern fills for apps; linear and radial gradients live only in springboard/src/shell/browser/tiles.rs.
- **Game Controller** (Partial, 50%): No controller discovery or connection events for apps (GCController.controllers, controllerDidConnect).; No gamepad input model: no buttons, axes, triggers, hats or direction-pad elements in the evdev decoder (springboard/src/bare/input.rs).; No SDK input profile for apps (extended, micro or racing wheel profiles).; No haptics or rumble API for controllers (springboard/src/bare/vibrator.rs only checks for a vibrator node).
- **GameSave** (Partial, 50%): Synced save directory API for apps (open a container, read and write files, sync in the background); Version history and conflict resolution for synced files; Sync status UI and the upload trigger (progress alert, pending upload); Save error domain (only needed once a sync API exists)
- **Metal Performance Shaders Graph** (Partial, 50%): No tensor or symbolic graph API for apps. A desktop SDK would need a graph type, a compiler and executables before any ML feature could land.; No app-facing GPU compute submission or completion callbacks. springboard/src/gpu/ serves only the compositor.; No neural-network operators (convolution, pooling, RNN) or FFT and random ops on the GPU.; No serialized executable format and no compilation cache.
- **MetalFX** (Partial, 50%): Motion vectors and depth input for temporal scaling: the presenter has no per-pixel motion or depth buffers.; Spatial upscaler on the GPU: only CPU bilinear resampling exists, in springboard/render/src/gfx.rs and springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs.; Frame interpolation (macOS 26 API) and the temporal denoiser: no counterpart.; App-facing scaler API in bifrost_app: none, so apps cannot request GPU upscaling of their own render targets.
- **MetalKit** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing GPU view with a per-frame delegate (MTKView and MTKViewDelegate equivalent) in springboard/sdk/src/; No app-facing GPU texture loader (MTKTextureLoader equivalent); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs decodes on the CPU only; No mesh container or mesh loading path (MTKMesh, MTKSubmesh equivalent); nothing under springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/render/src/; Presenter (springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs) is shell-internal; its Metal-shaped API has no SDK binding

### Media

- **iTunes Library** (Partial, 29%): No SDK module exposes the Music library or playlists to other apps (no equivalent of ITLibrary).; Playlists are .m3u files readable only by the Music app; no read API, no distinguished playlists.; No library change notification; Music polls its folders instead of using fswatch.; Per-track play statistics (playCount, lastPlayedDate, rating) are not stored in the library model.
- **Media Intelligence** (Partial, 30%): Face detection and person grouping for images, with a query API by asset, entity or face ID; On-device ML inference runtime that the analysis requests would run on; Video highlight scoring (engaging segments) over decoded frames; Content-based keyframe selection (representative frame) beyond container sync samples
- **AVKit** (Partial, 38%): Picture in Picture: no floating video window or PiP controller API; the Settings toggle pip_auto (springboard/src/shell/options.rs:72) is stored but never read by the shell.; App-facing video player view: the SDK player() widget (springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs:900) draws audio only; the fullscreen video HUD lives in springboard/src/deildu/player_view.rs and is not reusable by other apps.; Route picker: no AVRoutePickerView equivalent for AirPlay or nearby receivers; the AirPlay & Handoff page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs:598) is a settings screen only.; Capture: no SDK capture view or delegate (AVCaptureView); the camera is a single shell app (springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs).
- **AVRouting** (Partial, 38%): No system route picker or AirPlay-style destination list in the shell or SDK; No API for an app to register a third-party media receiver, its authorization, or its route activation state; No playback arbiter: apps cannot declare a preferred participant for external or non-mixable output; No discovery extension point for media receivers on the local network
- **Core MIDI** (Partial, 38%): No MIDI device I/O for apps: no client, input or output port, and no source or destination enumeration (MIDI Services).; No MIDI 1.0 or UMP message encoding and decoding; the DAW note model stores only pitch and velocity (model.rs:152).; No MIDI over Bluetooth LE (BLE MIDI service) on top of springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs.; No USB or hardware MIDI device hotplug, no system-level MIDI device registry, and no virtual endpoints.
- **CoreAudioKit** (Partial, 42%): No Audio Unit host: BifrOSt cannot load third-party AU plugins or show their custom views (AUViewController, AUAudioUnitViewConfiguration).; No generic audio unit view (AUGenericView) or panner view (AUPannerView) for plugins without a custom UI.; No BLE MIDI peripheral picker or local MIDI peripheral advertising (CABTMIDI* equivalents).; No network audio device browser (CANetworkBrowserWindowController equivalent) and no SDK route picker for apps.
- **Media Accessibility** (Partial, 43%): Caption appearance preferences: font, colours, opacity, edge style, window and display type, with a settings page and a change notification.; Caption and subtitle track support in the demuxers and the player (WebM drops subtitle tracks; MP4 has no text track), plus a caption renderer.; Audible media selection preferences (described video, music and sound descriptions) exposed to apps.; Flashing-light detection and dimming for video and UI, with a system setting and a change notification.
- **Media Library** (Partial, 43%): No app-facing SDK module for read-only media collections (nothing under springboard/sdk/src covers sources, groups or objects).; No source abstraction: Music and Photos each scan their own folders with their own code (springboard/src/shell/photos/library.rs and springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs).; Photo scanning is in the shell (springboard/src/shell/photos/library.rs), not in the SDK, so other apps cannot reuse it.; No generic media-object attribute dictionary; metadata is fixed structs per app.
- **Audio Unit** (Partial, 44%): No plug-in host for AU v2 or v3, and no way to load third-party audio processors into the DAW or any app.; No AUAudioUnit-style extension point for apps to ship audio processors.; No app-facing audio unit or render API; the DAW's rendering and devices are internal.; No MIDI input or MIDI event API.
- **Media Player** (Partial, 44%): No app-facing media library: no query, filter, collection or library change API (MPMediaQuery, MPMediaLibrary); the scan lives in springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music/library.rs.; No media picker for apps (MPMediaPickerController).; No remote command handlers for apps (MPRemoteCommandCenter); Control Center transport and hardware media keys are not exposed to apps (springboard/src/bare/input.rs:826 notes the media-key remote but does not map it).; No playlist, rating or feedback model in the SDK (MPMediaPlaylist, MPRatingCommand); favourites and playlists are private to the Music app.
- **PhotoKit** (Partial, 44%): No app-facing photo library API (PHPhotoLibrary): apps cannot fetch, load or create assets.; No system picker for apps: only Notes has a local camera-roll sheet that reads ~/Pictures directly.; No Live Photo support in the library or the viewer (PHLivePhoto).; No video assets in the Photos app (PHAsset video media type).
- **Sound Analysis** (Partial, 44%): No sound classifier: no built-in label set (over 300 sounds) and no Core ML audio model path; No SDK audio input API: the audio service records to a file only (RecordStart and RecordStop), so apps cannot receive a live buffer stream; No analysis of audio files: springboard/src/media/audiofile.rs decodes files only; No result types for time-ranged classifications with confidences, and no observer delivery to apps
- **AVFAudio** (Partial, 46%): No app-facing audio session category, mode or activation API (AVAudioSession); No interruption or route-change notifications for apps; No recording permission request or input mute state for apps (AVAudioApplication); No AVAudioEngine-style node graph for real-time processing
- **Now Playing** (Partial, 46%): No app-facing local media session: an app cannot publish its own metadata, state and commands to the lock screen or Control Center (MediaSession, MediaSessionRepresentable).; No typed content model: the service track has no title, artist, kind, or artwork, so the lock card cannot show metadata from apps other than Music.; No artwork transport or animated artwork through the audio service.; No remote media sessions across devices, no remote session extension and no device list; the Bluetooth route is only shown as a name.
- **Core Audio** (Partial, 46%): Per-process audio tap: capture the output of a process or a set of processes (AudioHardwareTap, CATapDescription).; Virtual audio device and driver plug-in (Audio Server Plug-in, AudioHardwarePlugin) or an app-facing loopback device.; Aggregate devices that combine several inputs and outputs with synchronized clocks (AudioHardwareAggregateDevice).; App-facing device and stream API: enumerate devices, open input and output streams and choose a device (AudioHardwareDevice, AudioHardwareStream).
- **AVFoundation (Playback, Editing, Common)** (Partial, 47%): No SDK media player for apps (everything is in the shell crate); No asset/track model or sample reader for apps; No composition, video composition or audio mix editing; No writer or export session; no encoder
- **Audio Toolbox** (Partial, 50%): No SDK API for raw audio buffers or render callbacks; apps can only use transport and record calls on the audio service; No audio unit or audio component host (AUv3 or AUv2), and no parameter tree; No system sound or alert API (AudioServices); No general format converter or encoder API for apps
- **Core Audio Types** (Partial, 50%): No shared audio format description type (sample rate, channel count, bits per sample, format flags) for apps or services; formats are passed as two loose integers.; No channel layout model: channel labels and layout tags are not carried through the audio path.; No timestamp model beyond presentation and decode times in microseconds (no host time or sample time).; No buffer-list type shared between the decoders, the speaker and the capture path.
- **ImageCaptureCore** (Partial, 50%): No device browser: no API or system service that enumerates PTP cameras and scanners and reports hotplug events (ICDeviceBrowser).; No PTP or MTP transport, so no camera file listing, download, delete or tethered capture (ICCameraDevice, ICCameraFile).; No scanner transport (SANE or similar) and no scan job API (ICScannerDevice).; No per-app USB device grant to match com.apple.security.device.usb in springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs.
- **MediaExtension** (Partial, 50%): No public extension point for third-party format readers, video decoders or RAW processors.; No public track reader or sample cursor API for apps; sample cursors are internal to springboard/src/media/demux/.; No RAW image processing (camera RAW decode, processing parameters) in springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs.; No property-list or manifest mechanism that registers a decoder for a four-character codec type.
- **PHASE** (Partial, 50%): No 3D sound: no source position, listener or orientation, and no spatialization or HRTF output; No occlusion, geometry or material acoustics; No reverb or environmental effects API; No sound event graph (switch, random, blend, container nodes) for apps
- **Quick Look Thumbnailing** (Partial, 50%): No QLThumbnailProvider extension point for custom file types; No system-wide thumbnail display in Files, Spotlight or the search panel; No thumbnail generator for PDF, text, audio, video or Live Photo files; only the Photos app decodes images; No representation types (icon, low quality, thumbnail) and no update or completion handlers
- **Screen Saver** (Partial, 50%): No screen saver plug-in host: no .saver bundle loading and no ScreenSaverView lifecycle (start, animate, stop).; No SDK class for ScreenSaverView, ScreenSaverDefaults or the SSRandom and SSCenteredRect helpers.; No preview or configuration sheet for screen savers in Settings.; Idle state is not exposed to apps: an app cannot learn that the system went idle or start its own idle animation.
- **AVFoundation (Capture, Audio)** (Partial, 54%): App-facing capture API (session, device discovery, inputs and outputs) for camera and microphone; Per-app camera and microphone permission prompts; Speech synthesis (voices, utterances, accessibility use); Audio engine graph with effects and buffers

### System

- **Authentication Services** (Partial, 28%): Web authentication session: an API that opens a sign-in page in an isolated session and returns the callback URL to the app (ASWebAuthenticationSession), with a callback scheme that the shell routes to the requesting app.; Passkeys and FIDO2: a platform authenticator, public-key credential registration and assertion, and WebAuthn support in the browser (springboard/apps/browser/README.md lists WebAuthn as broken).; Shared credential store and AutoFill: keychain access groups (shared items between apps), a save-password prompt, and a credential provider for the browser and other apps.; One-time passcodes: capture and suggestion of verification codes delivered to the device.
- **Force Feedback** (Partial, 29%): No evdev force-feedback path: EV_FF is not read, no EVIOCSFF effect upload, no play events (springboard/src/bare/input.rs has no EV_FF; grep count 0).; No device-level FF discovery or capability query for wheels and joysticks (springboard/src/bare/input.rs:299 parses bitmaps but not the FF bit).; No SDK API for effects (constant, periodic, ramp, spring and friction) or for gain and autocenter properties.; The SDK haptic() call is dropped by the shell (springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs:1184 default arm); there is no feedback path from an app to a device.
- **Disk Arbitration** (Partial, 38%): No disk mount, unmount, eject or appearance events for apps or shell (DARegister*Callback family).; No mount, unmount or eject approval hook, so nothing can block a volume change (DADissenter).; No app-facing disk or volume object with its description (DADisk, DADiskCopyDescription).; Files does not show mounted volumes or a Volumes sidebar section; document grants are confined to the account home.
- **Open Directory** (Partial, 42%): No client for LDAP or directory nodes: no session, node or record query API for apps.; No directory-backed user lookup or sign-in; the desktop has one local account.; No SDK call to verify or change the password of another account.; Contacts app cannot search a directory server for people.
- **DiskImageKit** (Partial, 43%): No SDK API to create, open or mount disk image files (RAW or ISO) for apps. Apps cannot do what DiskImageKit does for a user opening an ISO or disk image in Files.; Files has no ISO or image mount action, and no removable or mounted-volume eject path (springboard/apps/files/src).; No loop-device or userspace mount service in the system layer exposed to apps. The loop mount in tools/arch-vm.sh is developer tooling only.; No image metadata, resize or block-size API.
- **IOBluetooth UI** (Partial, 43%): No app-facing SDK API for Bluetooth pairing, device choice or status: the pairing and device list live only in the Settings Bluetooth page (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs).; No reusable device selector sheet or panel (IOBluetoothDeviceSelectorController).; No passkey or numeric comparison pairing: pairing is hardwired to NoInputNoOutput (springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:68-69), so devices that need a PIN or passkey cannot pair.; No SDP service browser: no service list or UUID-filtered selection (IOBluetoothServiceBrowserController).
- **LightweightCodeRequirements** (Partial, 43%): No code-signature verification of executables before launch or after download.; No signed identity (team or signing identifier) for apps, so identity cannot be tied to a developer.; No process peer identity check for control sockets or IPC (not verified; no SO_PEERCRED hits in the app host files).; No SDK API for apps to query identity, entitlements or validity of other code.
- **Network Extension** (Partial, 43%): No VPN client or tunnel: no IKEv2, IPsec, WireGuard or custom packet-tunnel provider, and the VPN settings page is a static placeholder.; No app-facing Wi-Fi configuration API (NEHotspotConfiguration equivalent): join and add-network are shell-only.; No content filter, URL filter or DNS proxy extension points for apps.; No system-wide encrypted DNS (DoH or DoT) settings; only DHCP-supplied resolvers are applied.
- **CryptoTokenKit** (Partial, 44%): No smart card reader or slot layer (PC/SC equivalent) in springboard/src/bare/ or anywhere else in the repo.; No token driver or app extension mechanism for hardware tokens.; No way to store, list or use keys or certificates held by a token (keychain is generic-password only, per docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Keychain' section).; No token-based login or two-factor factor for springboard/src/shell/login.rs.
- **External Accessory** (Partial, 44%): No SDK accessory manager or connect/disconnect events for apps (EAAccessoryManager).; No app-facing accessory object with protocol strings, manufacturer, model and connection ID (EAAccessory).; No EASession byte stream for a declared accessory protocol, and no manifest key or sandbox grant for accessory protocols (app_policy.rs binds only /dev/snd and /dev/dri).; No Bluetooth accessory picker callable from an app; the picker exists only in Settings (shell/pages.rs bluetooth_spec).
- **FSKit** (Partial, 44%): No user-space file system module API: no way for an app to ship and mount a file system, the core of FSKit; No SDK volume and item model (FSVolume, FSItem) for the Files app or third-party apps; No probe, mount or maintenance request path for apps or daemons (FSClient equivalent); No FSTask-style channel from a file system module to the shell for log and completion events
- **Local Authentication** (Partial, 44%): No biometric authentication (Touch ID, Face ID, fingerprint). Nothing in the shell or SDK; fprint, fprintd and howdy are absent.; No app-facing authentication API: an app cannot ask the user for the account password or passcode before a sensitive action (the LAContext evaluatePolicy equivalent).; Keychain items have no access control. Any item an app can read is readable without user presence (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Keychain, parity gaps).; No authentication-gated rights, persisted secrets or key pairs (LARight, LAPersistedRight, LASecret, LAPrivateKey).
- **GSS** (Partial, 46%): No GSS-API (RFC 2743/2744) implementation: no security contexts, credentials, names, tokens or message protection.; No Kerberos (krb5) client or ticket cache, so enterprise Kerberos sign-in and SPNEGO/Negotiate HTTP auth are unavailable to apps.; No SDK API for app-level GSS credentials; the keychain (springboard/sdk/src/keychain.rs) stores generic passwords only.; No mechanism or name registry (gss_indicate_mechs, GSSCreateName), so apps cannot select or compare authentication mechanisms.
- **CFNetwork** (Partial, 46%): No cookie storage or URLCredential/HTTP authentication for URLSession apps (springboard/sdk/src/url.rs); No host name lookup API for apps (CFHost); the resolver stays inside springboard/src/deildu/http.rs; No proxy configuration read or applied (CFNetworkCopySystemProxySettings); No Bonjour or network service browse and register API (CFNetService)
- **dnssd** (Partial, 46%): No app-facing DNS-SD API: apps cannot browse, resolve or advertise arbitrary service types (for example _ipp._tcp or _airplay._tcp).; No mDNS on port 5353 and no DNS-SD PTR/SRV/TXT records, so ordinary LAN devices cannot find BifrOSt and BifrOSt cannot find them.; No TXT record encoding or parsing.; No DNSServiceRef-style connection to a discovery daemon, and no dispatch-queue integration for discovery callbacks.
- **Network** (Partial, 46%): No app-facing raw TCP or UDP connection API (NWConnection, NWParameters, NWEndpoint); No app-facing listener API (NWListener); No service discovery (NWBrowser, mDNS or DNS-SD); the shell's UDP beacon is private; No QUIC, WebSocket or custom protocol framer
- **System Configuration** (Partial, 46%): No SDK client for the network service (svc::net). Apps cannot read Wi-Fi or link state, which the Apple reachability and dynamic-store APIs would give them. springboard/docs/services.md lists the client as planned.; No reachability test for a named host or address (SCNetworkReachability).; No system-wide preferences store for apps (SCPreferences), and no way to read or set the computer or host name.; No proxy configuration, and no VPN or PPP connection control (SCNetworkConnection).
- **Endpoint Security** (Partial, 47%): No system-level security event client: nothing connects to the kernel or the shell to receive process, file and session events.; No authorization hook: nothing can allow or deny an exec, open or mount before it happens.; Process events are limited to app launch and terminate from the shell; no exec arguments, environment, file descriptors, parent chain or processes outside the shell.; File events are content changes only, with no process attribution and no metadata, xattr or ACL events.
- **MetricKit** (Partial, 47%): No app-facing report API: no MXMetricManager equivalent delivers daily metric reports or diagnostic reports to an app.; No per-app metric collection beyond ProcessInfo counters: time-in-use, launch and resume timing, network, disk and GPU totals are not kept per app.; Crash and hang records are one-line log entries with no structured call-stack tree (CallStackTree, CallStackThread, CallStackFrame) available to apps.; No exception diagnostics for memory or CPU limit kills, and no termination counts by category.
- **Accelerate** (Partial, 50%): No SDK module for vDSP, vImage, BNNS, compression, BLAS/LAPACK, sparse solvers or simd.; No app-facing FFT or DCT API. The only FFT is private to the DAW convolver (springboard/apps/daw/src/conv.rs).; No compressor. DEFLATE is decode-only and lives in the Books engine, and the PNG writer stores uncompressed blocks.; No general image convolution, morphology, histogram, or arbitrary-angle geometric transform API.
- **Accessory Access** (Partial, 50%): No USB accessory manager, so an app cannot register to watch USB devices.; No attach and detach events delivered to apps for USB devices.; No matching criteria (vendor, product or class) for selecting accessories.; No USB device permission in the app permission manifest (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs), and no grant flow comparable to docbroker.rs for USB.
- **Darwin Notify** (Partial, 50%): No system-wide named notifications from the kernel or system services (time zone, clock, mount, network, disk space) to apps.; No notify_check, notify_register_signal, notify_set_state or notify_get_state equivalents.; No suspend or resume of observers, and no hold-for-later delivery to apps that are not running.; Observers always run on the main thread; no caller-chosen dispatch queue.
- **Exception Handling** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing SDK API to install a panic or uncaught-failure handler, or to read crash.log entries from an app; No per-failure delegate decision (shouldHandle / shouldLogException) and no handling or logging mask; No debugger-halt policy for selected failures; a panic aborts the release build after the hook writes; Panic isolation exists only in SDK dispatch and shell job pools, not for arbitrary app code
- **Finder Sync** (Partial, 50%): No file-manager extension point: apps cannot add badges, context-menu items or toolbar buttons to Files.; No selection or targeted-folder API for other apps to query the file manager.; No per-item tag, last-used or attribute sharing with the file manager.; No extension host or enable UI for file-manager plugins.
- **HIDDriverKit** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing API for raw HID reports, elements or usage tables; Stylus and pen data (pressure, tilt, eraser) is not decoded; Touch decoding tracks only the first contact (slot 0); No app-facing device matching or hotplug notification by HID usage
- **InputMethodKit** (Partial, 50%): No input method provider: no IMKServer, IMKInputController or input method registration (springboard/src/shell/textinput.rs header).; No candidates window (IMKCandidates); popup_origin in springboard/src/shell/textinput.rs only places a popup, and nothing draws it.; The keyboard app does not send Preedit yet (springboard/apps/keyboard), so composition is not produced by anything in practice.; No IMKServerInput event routing (inputText, didCommand, handle) through a provider; no composedString, originalString or candidates queries.
- **IOBluetooth** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing Bluetooth SDK module: nothing under springboard/sdk/src/ covers Bluetooth.; No RFCOMM, OBEX or SDP support (no code anywhere in springboard/).; No hands-free (call control) profile.; No app API to open L2CAP channels to arbitrary PSMs or receive device events.
- **IOUSBHost** (Partial, 50%): No app-facing API to claim a USB device, read descriptors or send control, bulk, interrupt or isochronous requests (IOUSBHostDevice, IOUSBHostInterface, IOUSBHostPipe, IOUSBHostStream).; The app sandbox (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs) does not bind USB device nodes, so a sandboxed app cannot reach raw USB even if an API existed.; No scanner API and no USB transport for printers (springboard/sdk/src/print.rs).; Owner decision needed: whether a desktop needs app-level raw USB access at all. The triage note says likely n/a; the framework's stated use cases (cameras, audio, scanners, printers, MIDI, hubs) are mostly covered at the system layer, which leaves custom device drivers as the real gap.
- **Local Authentication Embedded UI** (Partial, 50%): No biometric authentication in the system layer, so there is no state for LAAuthenticationView to show (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Login window gaps: "no biometric or paired-device unlock").; No SDK API equivalent to an authentication context or to LAAuthenticationView, and no control size token for it.; The login screen password flow (springboard/src/shell/login.rs) is the only authentication UI; it cannot show biometric state until a biometric source exists.
- **Security** (Partial, 50%): Certificate and trust evaluation API (SecTrust, SecPolicy, SecIdentity) for apps; the SDK has no certificate types; Code signing and signature verification for apps and updates; the update manifest is not signed; Authorization Services: an app-facing authorization API for privileged operations; Randomization API (SecRandomCopyBytes equivalent) in the SDK
- **Security Interface** (Partial, 50%): No certificate panel, certificate view or certificate trust editor. The shell has no certificate display or trust UI.; No choose-identity panel. Keychain items cannot hold identities, keys or certificates.; No keychain save or settings panel. The keychain SDK has no UI and no user-facing keychain settings.; No authorization lock view for apps. Apps cannot show a padlock or request an admin password through an SDK control; the privd password gate is not exposed to apps.
- **System** (Partial, 50%): No SDK file-descriptor type with typed open options, positional read and write, seek, duplicate and pipe creation.; No SDK path type with component views. Apps use Rust std::path only.; No SDK stat call or typed file mode, file type and permission set.; No SDK call for volume capacity. disk_space in springboard/src/bare/sys.rs:125 is shell-only.
- **Virtualization** (Partial, 50%): An SDK module that creates, starts, pauses and stops a Linux guest (VZVirtualMachine counterpart) with a sandboxed launcher; A guest display view that can be placed in a desktop window; Virtio device configuration for app-created guests: storage, network, entropy, memory balloon, serial console; Shared directories and clipboard bridging between host and guest
- **XPC** (Partial, 50%): No SDK API for XPC-style typed sessions between an app and a helper (XPCListener, XPCSession, XPCReceivedMessage).; No app-facing way to declare a helper service that the system launches on demand and shuts down when idle. bifrostd only restarts services.; No XPC activity scheduler (criteria, intervals, deferral, system-run callback) in the SDK.; No endpoint objects for passing a connection to another process, and no peer requirement beyond the owner UID.
- **Service Management** (Partial, 54%): Launch agents and launch daemons: SMAppService.agent(plistName:) and daemon(plistName:) (the SDK doc states none exist); Embedded helper executables registered from the app bundle, including loginItem(identifier:); Service Management error values (kSMError*, SMAppServiceErrorDomain): the SDK has no error type and the shell reply carries no error; unregister(completionHandler:) and the error value it returns
- **Core Services** (Partial, 56%): Apple Events: no typed inter-app messages with reply descriptors; the control socket and intents do not replace them.; File metadata: no attribute store or MDQuery-style query API for apps.; Dictionary Services: no definition lookup (spellcheck.rs covers spelling only).; Backup Core: no per-item backup exclusion.
- **os** (Partial, 57%): Signposts: no OSSignposter or os_signpost equivalent (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1041 names it as Phase 3); OSAllocatedUnfairLock: no unfair-lock wrapper in the SDK; Per-value privacy and format specifiers: privacy is per subsystem only; Log reading: no persistent position tokens and the journal reader depends on journalctl
- **Dispatch** (Partial, 58%): DispatchSource beyond memory pressure: no timer, read, write, signal or process sources, and no cancel, suspend or resume (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1095); DispatchIO channels and DispatchData buffers; Barriers on concurrent queues and target queues (setTarget); concurrentPerform and asyncAndWait
- **OSLog** (Partial, 62%): OSSignposter and signpost entries (phase 3 in docs/milestone-unified-logging.md); Activity, boundary and payload entry types and OSLogMessageComponent; Lazy OSLogEnumerator and persistent OSLogPosition tokens (LogStore::entries returns a Vec); Per-argument privacy (.public, .private(mask:)) and format specifiers; privacy is per subsystem only
- **Uniform Type Identifiers** (Partial, 71%): App-declared exported and imported types with extension, MIME and conformance (UTExportedTypeDeclarations equivalent); Generic UTTagClass API beyond filenameExtension and mimeType; Most of the system-declared identifiers on the landing page, including 3D, Apple-only, Shazam and bundle types; Writable types and type conversion for documents

### Web

- **Link Presentation** (Partial, 50%): No SDK API that fetches a URL's title, icon, image and video (LPMetadataProvider equivalent), with a timeout and cancel; No rich link view widget (LPLinkView equivalent) in the shared kit, with placeholder and metadata modes; The News app's og:image scrape (springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/pictures.rs) is app-local and not reusable by other apps; The share sheet sends URLs as plain items and does not show a rich link preview
- **Screen Time** (Partial, 50%): Web-usage reporting: no equivalent of STWebpageController to report visited URLs, playing video or picture-in-picture, or to ask whether a URL is blocked.; Web-history API: no equivalent of STWebHistory to fetch or delete browsing history by bundle identifier, profile or date range.; Configuration query: apps cannot observe the device Screen Time configuration or ask whether child restrictions are enforced.; Web-usage data in the Settings chart and no URL block list, so the shield covers apps only.

## Work themes (Gap rows clustered by meaning)

Gap rows from all frameworks, embedded on Titan and clustered (`bifrost pc parity themes`); one theme is one
piece of work that closes gaps in several frameworks at once.

| Theme | Gap rows | Frameworks |
|---|---|---|
| Render destinations and video filtering (CIRenderDestination, CIImageAccumulator) | 29 | Core Image, SceneKit, Model I/O, Metal Performance Shaders, Application Services, Metal, MetricKit, GLKit and 13 more |
| Apple Events (inter-process messages with replies) | 28 | Core Services, SwiftUI (App structure, Data and storage), App Intents, Safari Services, Authentication Services, User Notifications, Swift, Service Management and 12 more |
| Contextual embedding (NLContextualEmbedding) | 26 | Natural Language, QuickLook UI, Core Foundation, Core Media I/O, Media Player, Core Spotlight, Core Location, Media Library and 14 more |
| Live audio classification sample | 19 | Sound Analysis, Speech, Core ML, SceneKit, SiriKit, Media Intelligence, Music Understanding, AVFAudio and 7 more |
| Clusters (typed On/Off, Level Control, Switch and others) | 18 | Matter, MatterSupport, Network Extension, Media Accessibility, PermissionKit, Core Location, SceneKit, External Accessory and 8 more |
| Hand text and files to a mail compose window | 16 | MailKit, Social, User Notifications, SwiftData, Accounts, ReplayKit, File Provider, Local Authentication and 7 more |
| Channel Sounding (distance measurement) | 9 | Core Bluetooth, AVRouting, IOBluetooth UI, Now Playing, CoreAudioKit, Core MIDI, Force Feedback |
| Synchronization (OSAllocatedUnfairLock) | 7 | os, Disk Arbitration, Dispatch, dnssd, Synchronization, Combine |
| View configuration (environment, modifiers, state) | 7 | SwiftUI (Views, View layout), AppKit (Text), TipKit, PencilKit, Notification Center, Contacts |
| On-device system language model (SystemLanguageModel) | 6 | Foundation Models, Natural Language, Core ML, Core AI, Evaluations |
| Public-key signatures (Curve25519 Ed25519, P256, P384, P521) | 5 | Apple CryptoKit, CryptoTokenKit |

## Matrix

<a id="accessibility"></a>
### Accessibility

Partial · coverage 50% · macOS 11.0 · [official docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/accessibility) · REA `ev_2a505504e4634c45494730263b3e9dd7da9a8a53b707a6c6c2a02409b4820b58`

BifrOSt covers a Linux AT-SPI2 screen-reader bridge (roles, states, text attributes, text events, announcements, secure fields) and system display settings (zoom, reduce motion, increase contrast, reduce transparency, larger and bold text) that apps can read. The hierarchy API exists in the SDK but no app uses it yet, and there is no Accessibility Inspector, Switch Control, Voice Control, Braille, or audio-graph support.

| Feature | Apple API | BifrOSt | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Screen reader bridge (VoiceOver equivalent) | Accessibility API, VoiceOver, NSAccessibility element hierarchy | springboard/src/shell/atspi/bridge.rs, springboard/src/shell/atspi/model.rs, springboard/src/shell/atspi/mod.rs | Partial | AT-SPI2 bus export of Accessible, Component, Action, Value, Text and EditableText; roles and states mapped in model.rs; unit tests only, untested on a live Orca. Feature-gated behind the atspi cargo feature. |
| Element role mapping | AccessibilityTechnology, NSAccessibility roles | springboard/src/shell/atspi/model.rs:37 (atspi_role) | Partial | Button, TextField, List, Row, Toggle, Checkbox, Slider, SegmentedControl, StaticText, MenuItem, Window are mapped; no table, selection, or rotor roles. |
| Element hierarchy (parent, focus, checked state) | NSAccessibility accessibilityChildren and accessibilityParent | springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:104 (controls_tree), springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs:91 and :241, springboard/proto/src/lib.rs (NodeExt) | Partial | The SDK exposes controls_tree and View::controls_tree, but no app in springboard/apps overrides it yet, so every app reads as a flat list under its window. |
| Labels, titles and help text | accessibilityLabel, accessibilityTitle, accessibilityHelp | springboard/ui/src/ax.rs (AxMeta), springboard/src/shell/atspi/bridge.rs | Partial | Name falls back from label to title, Description from help to role name; SDK hooks App::ax_meta and View::ax_meta exist. |
| Text attributes and text events | AXSelectedText, AXSelectedTextRange, AXVisibleCharacterRange, text change notifications | springboard/ui/src/ax.rs (AxText), springboard/src/shell/atspi/bridge.rs | Partial | Caret, selection and visible range are exported as char offsets; TextChanged, TextCaretMoved and TextSelectionChanged are diffed on publish. Implemented for the shell TextField only, plus the sign-in sheet's fields. |
| Secure text fields | isSecureTextEntry fields | springboard/ui/src/ax.rs (secure flag), springboard/src/shell/atspi/model.rs (build_ax) | Partial | Value is masked and selected text is always empty; only the length crosses the wire. |
| Accessibility announcements | AccessibilityNotification, announcement requested (low, medium, high priority) | springboard/ui/src/ax.rs:52 (announce priority), Ctx::announce in the SDK | Partial | Maps to AT-SPI Object:Announcement with politeness; at most 8 pending per app. Live on a screen reader not verified. |

Shared kit sliders and text fields do not yet. |

No single SDK AccessibilitySettings struct. |
| Display Zoom and magnification | Zoom, Display Zoom setting | springboard/src/shell/accessibility/mod.rs (ZOOMS: Standard, Larger), springboard/src/shell/magnifier.rs | Partial | Display Zoom is a 1.0 or 1.15 geometry factor, not a system-wide zoom. Magnifier is a camera loupe with digital zoom and filters, not a screen magnifier. No screen-wide zoom. |
| Pointer and touch accommodations | AssistiveTouch, Touch Accommodations (hold duration) | springboard/src/shell/assistive_touch.rs, springboard/src/shell/accessibility/mod.rs (HOLD_MS) | Partial | A floating Home button with six system shortcuts, plus hold-duration settings from 0.5 s to 2 s. No pointer-based keys or dwell control. |

No switch scanning code found in springboard/ (search for switch control and dwell returned nothing). |
| Voice Control | Voice Control (AccessibilityTechnology.voiceControl) | springboard/ui/src/voice_commands.rs | Partial | Wave 4 (theme-15, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No voice command code found in springboard/. |

No audio graph or hearing aid API found in this pass. |

Gaps: No app emits controls_tree, so the parent and hierarchy API is unused and every app is a flat list to screen readers.; The AT-SPI bridge is untested on a live Orca; unit tests cover only wire round trips and mapping.; Shell chrome (menu bar, dock, Spotlight, Settings pages) is missing from the AT-SPI tree.; ax_set ignores SetValue and Focus unless an app overrides it; the shared kit's sliders and text fields do not.; No Accessibility Inspector for developers to see an app's accessibility tree.; No Switch Control, Voice Control, Braille, or audio graph support.; Display Zoom is a 1.15 geometry factor, not a system-wide zoom, and the Magnifier is a camera loupe, not a screen magnifier.; Doc drift: docs/bifrost-ui.md lines 211-223 still list announcements, caret and secure fields as missing in the parity gaps, while the Closed-in-the-text-round section and ax.rs describe them as implemented. Reconcile the doc..

### AppKit (Graphics, Drawing, Color, and Printing)

Partial · coverage 50% · macOS 10.0 · [official docs](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appkit) · REA `ev_c13e34ac0a796f139c7afc1ac6d88343b2a61a27ec40e0a76c53e92c372eebaf`

Semantic colours, a colour panel, PNG/JPEG decoding, procedural symbol glyphs, a software 2D Surface and CUPS printing exist. There is no NSImage-like object model, no Bezier path or gradient API for apps, no colour spaces or colour lists, and no print sheet.

| Images and PDF: symbol images | NSImage(systemSymbolName:), NSImage.SymbolConfiguration | springboard/sdk/src/glyphs.rs, springboard/render/src/symbols.rs | Partial | fixed set of procedural line glyphs (59), one weight, no hierarchical or palette rendering (docs/bifrost-ui.md) |
